items.text: Aesir Interactive will be live on Twitch and YouTube to play Ambulance Life while discussing the recent patches, community feedback, and the future of the project!
We will start the stream live in Munich, Germany on Thursday, March 6th from 08:00 PST / 17:00 CET so mark those calendars!
We are listening extremely closely to community feedback, but as we make sweeping changes, there may be still players who have unique cases that need special care.

If even after installing the last three technical patches, you are still experiencing crashes, freezes, and black screens, we need specific files from your computer to find direct solutions for your problems.
Please follow the instructions from this link to get us your specific files so we can investigate solutions for your case here:
Multiple Crash Fixes.
Significantly reduced the likelihood of our NPC Cars bouncing around randomly.
Cars will no longer crash into Callout Scenes.
Fixed a bug where the driving camera snaps back after a manual reset.
Fixed several Instances where patient’s arms would clip into their sides.
Fixed Several Visual Issues with our Callout Assets.
Fixed Several Visual Issues with our World Assets.
Fixed Several Issues where patient’s arms would be twisted.
Fixed a Bug where you could get stuck on the First Shift.
Fixed several markings on the highway which were pointing in the wrong direction.
Fixed flickering UI.
Removed several invisible Barriers.
Fixed a Bug in the Introductory Shift where the Partner refused to exit the Ambulance.
Removed Hospital Markers that are in locked districts.
Reduced the odds of the stretcher getting stuck on the Ambulance Door.
Fixed the Parking Assist Sounds.
The patient Protocol Body Temperate will now always correctly be in the unit that the player has selected.
Deactivated another Cactus collision. (lol)
Fixed a wrong icon being shown upon unlocking the glucometer.
Fixed build ID showing twice in the splash screen.
Fixed a flaw in the parking validation and adjusted the colliders on the ambulances.
Fixed white placeholder Icons.
Fixed flickering Skid Marks.
Fixed Anamnesis Camera Positions in Catastrophic Event 01 (The Freeway Catastrophe).
Fixed several floating Assets.
Fixed floating stretcher in Cutscenes.
Fixed the Lighting in the Customization Scene.
Fixed further Glass Visuals in Catastrophic Event 02 (The Burning Mall).
Fixed Railings Visuals in Catastrophic Event 02 (The Burning Mall).
Improved performance on Lower Graphics Settings.
Added an automatic HDD/SSD detection.

More PSO Caching: Reduced the amount of lag spikes, especially on High and Ultra Settings. This will cause the initial loading screen after downloading the patch for the first time to be a bit longer.
Significantly Improved overall Visuals through due to the activation of Ambient Occlusion and Global Illumination (Also for Consoles):
Enabled traffic density setting on consoles.
Enabled video settings tab on consoles to be able to tune the following Settings:
Brightness/Gamma
HDR settings
UI scaling
Color Blind settings
Toggle Motion Blur
Toggle Bloom
Toggle Lens Flare
Toggle Depth of Field
Updated Lighting to not have overly blueish tone in shadowed areas.
Improved Main Menu Layout and UI.
Selected Tools will no longer remain in your hand and clip through the screen when opening the patient Protocol.
Disabled NVidia Frame Generation by default to prevent UI artifacts and screen tearing. These can be re-enabled for a performance Boost!
Enabled text wrapping in several handbook elements.
Removed duplicate Evidence from the Handbook
Added some additional Feedback for when Patients went into Ventricular Fibrillation:
Simulation Mode will now additionally deactivate the following guidance Features:
The patient Protocol will no longer directly tell you which clues point to which Diagnosis Options by providing red/green ratings.
The Recommended Treatment steps after selecting a Diagnosis will no longer be shown in the Treatment HUD.
Players will no longer be able to load the Last Checkpoint after going Game Over.
Balanced the Callout Director to more evenly distribute our different callouts.
Reduced maximum waiting time for next callout from 50s to 30s.
Switching patient from a police officer to a homeless person in training callout 03.
Added an automatic Discovery for very close patients.
Catastrophic Events will now Trigger even when approached from the wrong side.
Increased the Odds of Preexisting Conditions to appear on patients.
Increased the maximum Output of the Thermostat to 98°F/37°C.
Patients will now change their skin color a bit more slowly when their body temperature changes.
Slightly reduced patient’s base blood sugar consumption.
Added an Option to Invert X and Invert Y Axis.
Added Advanced Tooltips to our Tools which briefly summarize their effect:
Added a Reset to Default Button to our menus.
Added additional Player Guidance Recommendations to the Callout Overview UI.
We will now Highlight Life Saving measures if appropriate Evidence has been discovered.
Scoring Screen may not be initialized properly after a Tutorial Mission.
Switching between different menus in the Customization Settings may temporarily remove hair from characters.

We are evaluating our next steps as we gear up another major patch this month and the Bayside Expansion release next month, so please stay tuned here and our official Discord for all the latest news and updates.

Thank you for sharing your feedback and experiences with us as we continue to pushing for these sweeping updates to address your concerns. Thank you for helping us continue shape Ambulance Life into the best version of itself it can be! ❤️

items.text: Aesir Interactive will be live on Twitch and YouTube to play Ambulance Life while discussing the recent patches, community feedback, and the future of the project!
We will start the stream live in Munich, Germany on Tuesday, February 25th from 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET so mark those calendars!
We are listening extremely closely to community feedback, but as we make sweeping changes, there may be still players who have unique cases that need special care.

If even after installing the last three technical patches, you are still experiencing crashes, freezes, and black screens, we need specific files from your computer to find direct solutions for your problems.
Please follow the instructions from this link to get us your specific files so we can investigate solutions for your case here:

Improved PSO Precaching: We fixed an issue where players would experience severe Lag when starting the game for the First time. After downloading the patch, the first loading screen is expected to be prolonged for that one initial time.
Multiple Crash Fixes.
Added a failsafe for save game corruption that can occur if the game crashes while autosaving.
Fixed a Bug where the post-callout summary screen would have “UNSELECTED” as the recommended Diagnosis Option.
Fixed a bug that prevented players from entering the ambulance side door during the Treatment Phase.
Fixed faulty Settings for Foliage and View Distance.
Removed some invisible collisions.
Fixed some NPCs getting stuck on callout props.
Fixed Glass Visuals in Catastrophic Event 02 (The Burning Mall).
Fixed Fire Visuals in Catastrophic Event 02 (The Burning Mall).
Consoles Only: Fixed a bug that caused the wheels of NPVs to stop turning.
We improved the Patient Protocol to show which Diagnoses are not unlocked yet. You will unlock more of these diagnoses by naturally progressing through the game and leveling up.

Callout Director: We significantly reduced the likelihood of the same callout triggering multiple times in a row and also increased the chances of callouts spawning in your shift’s starting district. (It is still possible for Callouts to spawn in neighboring Districts). Additionally, if a new Callout type has been unlocked, then this Callout type is always guaranteed to spawn in the next shift.
Increased the speed of new Unlocks during earlier Levels.
The Game will now be paused when you open the Handbook.
Changed the Layout of the Waterfront HQ base to make it less likely to be boxed in by traffic when a new shift starts.
Reduced the number of Delivery Trucks in the City.
Added a “Reset to Default” Button to the Settings menu.
Added an info Box to Game Over Screens informing players that they can change the Game Over settings.
Made the Partner less chatty during Treatment.
Difficulty for Catastrophic events has been adjusted for slightly easier S-Scores.
We look forward to delivering the next phase of major updates in the coming weeks, so please stay tuned here and our official Discord for all the latest news and updates.

Thank you for sharing your feedback and experiences with us as we continue to pushing for these sweeping updates to address your concerns. Thank you for helping us continue shape Ambulance Life into the best version of itself it can be! ❤️

Next week, we will be releasing another hotfix fixing even more issues. (We’ll share more details in due time)

Hello Paramedics,
🚑 Ambulance Life is finally here! A huge thank you for all your feedback. Your input helps us improve the game, and thanks to it, we’re bringing you the first patch.

The team has been working hard to deliver a first patch addressing key issues. This patch brings significant improvements to gameplay, visuals, and overall performance. We've improved emergency callouts, improved patient interactions, and made the experience smoother and more immersive...
Performance & Stability - Updated XeSS & DLSS settings, enabled ray tracing with Lumen, and optimized game performance.
Gameplay Adjustments - Added and updated gunshot callouts, deactivated cactus collision, and adjusted pedestrian/traffic density across all quality settings.
Medical System Tweaks - Replaced Epinephrine with Saline in shock treatment, added penalties for untreated patients, and improved diagnosis progression.
New Features - Introduced an auto-benchmark button to adjust the graphics settings to your PC performance and a Triage Tag Guidance Widget.
UI & Accessibility - Improved handbook readability, UI scaling, and sound feedback when interacting with menus.
AI & Dialogue - Reduced repetitive partner dialogue, improved patient conversations, and fixed lip sync issues.
Visual Enhancements - Lighting improvements, optimized smoke effects, prettier fountain water, and fixed floating objects.
Bug Fixes - Fixed disappearing bite marks, misplaced NPCs, incorrect animations, and patient repositioning issues.
Collision & Environment Fixes - Adjusted collisions for trees, traffic lights, wooden planks, and vehicles to prevent glitches.
Crash Fixes - Addressed crashes related to callouts, menu interactions, and world assets to improve game stability.
Read the detailed patch note below for more information.

items.text: Hello Medics!

First above all, we want to thank you for sharing all your critical feedback with our teams. Ambulance Life is a major milestone for us, and we want it to be just as special for you. We are committed to patching these issues into oblivion.
⚠️An update is coming as soon as it's confirmed and certified, which is most likely late tonight or early tomorrow morning. You will know as soon as we do!
All the tickets you've been submitting to MyNacon has been PIVOTAL in our investigations and solutions for all upcoming. Please continue submitting tickets to the MyNacon support portal.
We are constantly listening, collecting, and triaging your reports for immediate action. Our developers are working around the clock to find solutions.
Performance Improvements.
Multiple collisions, visuals and localization bug fixes.
Change of the Guidance Widget about the Triage Tags.
Addition of a score for the application, or not, of life saving measures.
Patient Protocol now shows only tool, diagnoses, and procedures unlocked by the player.
Addition of multiple ambient sounds of the city and modification of the UI's sounds.
⚠️In the meantime, and even after this patch update, players may review the below solutions to significantly improve their performance in most cases.
Manually deleting your Ambulance Life configuration settings file will safely allow the game to automatically re-create this file with the recommended settings.

notes.title: This file can be located here

items.text: C:\Users\NAME\AppData\Local\Sanka\Saved\Config\Windows\GameUserSettings.ini
Ambulance Life must be installed to SSD storage to function properly. Players will see significant performance issues if the game is installed to an HDD.
If you have already installed Ambulance Life to an HDD or an external SSD, Steam allows easy migration of your installation files to another drive of your choice!

notes.title: Games are installed to the following folder by default

items.text: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common
How do I move a game's installation folder?
To move a game's installation folder on your computer to a different location on that same computer you can use Steam's "Move" feature. To use this option do the following:
Make sure you have a different Steam Library path created to move to (see the instructions in how to add a Steam Library folder above)
Navigate to your Steam client 'Settings' menu.
Open the 'Storage' tab.
Select the drive where the games you wish to move are located.
Select the games you wish to move, and click 'Move'
Enabling TSR in the Anti-Aliasing settings can help improve performance.
Go to "Settings"
Navigate to the "Video" tab
Click on "Show Advanced"
Go to "Anti-Aliasing / Super Resolution Method" and scroll through the options to select "TSR"
These Density options are heavily CPU intensive, but can also directly affect GPU rendering, as well.
In the settings menu, you can adjust the traffic density in San Pelícano.
While a high traffic density adds to realism, it also requires more processing power.
Lowering it can help improve performance on lower-end systems.

To reiterate, if you are still experiencing issues, please reach out to our support team on the MyNacon support portal with as many details as possible. Your reports help our developers better understand and resolve any problems. ❤️
Make sure your PC meets the minimum, recommended, or optimal system requirements to run the game as smoothly as possible.
🤏Minimum Specifications
OPERATING SYSTEM: Windows 10
PROCESSOR: Intel Core i7-8700K or AMD Ryzen 7 1800X
MEMORY: 16 GB RAM
GRAPHICS: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980, 4 GB or AMD Radeon RX 590, 8 GB or Intel Arc A380, 6 GB
DETAILS: 1080p Low @ 30 FPS w/ TSR @ 66% Resolution Scaling
STORAGE: SSD Required
👌 Recommended Specifications
OPERATING SYSTEM: Windows 10
PROCESSOR: Intel Core i7-12700K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
MEMORY: 16 GB RAM
GRAPHICS: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 Ti SUPER, 8 GB or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT, 8 GB or Intel Arc A770, 16 GB
DETAILS: 1080p High @ 30 FPS w/ TSR @ 71% Resolution Scaling
STORAGE: SSD Required
💪 Optimum Specifications
OPERATING SYSTEM: Windows 10
PROCESSOR: Intel Core i9-14900K or AMD Ryzen 9 7950X
MEMORY: 32 GB RAM
GRAPHICS: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080, 16 GB or AMD Radeon RX 7900XT, 24 GB
